$comment: Types the engine reaches through reflective/generic adapters (type names never appear literally in the source, so the lexical audit cannot see them). Each entry names the tool, how it reaches the type and the real-project evidence. Audit-OpennessCoverage.ps1 reports matching UNTOUCHED / TYPE_NAMED_NO_MEMBER types as DYNAMIC. Patterns match the full type name; * is a wildcard.
